statement: For displacement a > 1/2 (so sigma = 1/2 + a > 1) and any Schwartz window W in S(R), the infinite prime-side logarithmic derivative P(s) = -zeta'/zeta(s) = sum_{n>=2} Lambda(n) n^{-s} under centered grade dilation s_h = 1/2 + tau^h (a + it) satisfies absolute double summability sum_{m,n>=2} |c_m c_n| int |W(t)| (|a+it| log n + |a+it|^2 (log n)^2) dt < infty with majorant bound |c_n| (log n)^j <= n^{-(1/2+a)} (log n)^{j+1}. By Fubini-Tonelli and Dominated Convergence, the infinite-window inner product converges to <F_0, ddot F_0>_W = (log tau)^2 sum_{m,n>=2} c_m bar(c_n) I_{m,n}(W), matching continuous 1D quadrature within certified analytic tail bounds.

quantified_variables.name: a
quantified_variables.description: Real displacement parameter sigma - 1/2 in the absolute convergence half-plane

quantified_variables.name: W
quantified_variables.domain: W in S(R) or C_c^infty(R), W >= 0, int W = 1

hypotheses: P(s) = sum_{n>=2} Lambda(n) n^{-s} on Re(s) = 1/2 + a > 1
F_0(t) = sum_{n>=2} c_n e^{-it log n}
ddot F_0(t) = (log tau)^2 sum_{n>=2} c_n [ -(a+it) log n + (a+it)^2 (log n)^2 ] e^{-it log n}
object_studied: Infinite prime-side Dirichlet series grade second-variation inner product <F_0, ddot F_0>_W
fourier_normalization: Centered coordinates z = a + it; tau = 2pi; Fourier transform hat{f}(xi) = int_{-infty}^infty f(t) e^{-it xi} dt
multiplicity_convention: Standard von Mangoldt arithmetic weights Lambda(n)
measure_and_window: Schwartz probability measure W(t) dt on R
order_of_limits: Truncation limit N -> infty evaluated before real-line integral; dominated convergence interchange justified by finite majorants
exact_conclusion: <F_0, ddot F_0>_W = (log tau)^2 sum_{m,n>=2} c_m bar(c_n) I_{m,n}(W); partial sums converge absolutely with tail bound O(N^{1/2-a} log^3 N); infinite double sum matches 1D continuous quadrature
logical_negation: The double series-integral diverges or partial sums do not converge to the 1D continuous inner product for some a > 1/2 (FALSIFIED by explicit majorant summability and dominated convergence)
falsification_attempts: Evaluated boundary limit a -> 1/2^+ where tail bound diverges as 1/(sigma-1)
Tested extreme window widths sigma_W in {0.1, 1.0, 10.0}
Compared truncation max_n in {10, 30, 50, 100} against continuous adaptive quadrature in mpmath and Arb
Verified absolute convergence of all three log moment majorants j in {0, 1, 2}

external_sources.theorem: Theorem 1.2 & Chapter 5 (Dirichlet series absolute convergence and termwise differentiation)
